track.insider_note: How to read the insider rows — we don’t push everything. Our AI reads each Form 4 and checks the business against our theme database (semiconductor CapEx ramp, memory / AIDC, advanced packaging…), then weighs who bought and how much of their own money. An open-market insider buy shows the insider’s own cost basis — a firmer signal than talk. A higher score is a name we lean toward; losers are listed too.
